{{Top|leg}}
A '''caniphant''' was a four-legged creature with a tapered snout. They grew to lengths of 1.2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, and stood .75 meters high. They were employed as guard animals. [[Ellam]] kept three in a [[force cage]] in his [[Honest Ellam's Speeder Lot|speeder lot]].
